description: This file defines the RedirectMiddleware class used in GuzzleHttp to handle HTTP request redirects, including managing redirect limits, tracking redirect history, and modifying requests according to redirect responses.

classes.name: RedirectMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling HTTP redirects in GuzzleHttp, managing redirect logic, headers, and request modifications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next handler callable.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, checking whether redirects are allowed and handling them accordingly.

methods.name: checkRedirect
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates a redirect, manages redirect limits, and prepares the next request.

methods.name: withTracking
methods.description: Enables redirect tracking by updating headers with redirect history.

methods.name: guardMax
methods.description: Checks and enforces the maximum number of redirects to prevent infinite loops.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Modifies the request for a redirect, adjusting method, headers, and URI.

methods.name: redirectUri
methods.description: Resolves and validates the redirect URI based on the Location header.
